text:
maria: Quick sync — Aurora private rollout checklist. Primary asks: final egress ACL, proxy cert rotation plan, and airgap image handoff. Who's owning each?

sam: I can own egress ACLs. Working with infra to confirm destination ranges. Will post a diff for the terraform once I have the final IP ranges.

ashok: I can take proxy cert rotation. Need to know if we do rolling or single-window replace (customer prefers low-connectivity window). Proposing rolling with 5m drain per proxy.

jen: For airgap images, ops wants a tarball + sha256. I have the build tag ready: `redwood-inference-aurora-20260314`. Upload scheduled to secure-artifacts at 02:00 UTC. Who will verify checksums on the customer side?

aaron: @jen I'll coordinate verification with the customer's ops lead (Elena). We agreed to SCP + signed checksum via S3 pre-signed URL earlier. I'll confirm the SCP endpoint and creds.

maria: Thanks. Sam — can you confirm whether the egress set needs 443+80 only or also the pull mirrors on 8443? Customer said some mirrors are on 8443.

sam: Egress needs 443 and 8443. Adding a note in the terraform: `aws_security_group_rule` allow tcp 443,8443 -> mirror CIDRs. I'll post PR in ~30m.

ashok: Rolling cert plan sounds good. Two quick Qs: 1) does the proxy support SNI fallback? 2) do we have a fallback cert (short lived) if rotation fails?

jen: Proxy supports SNI fallback. We do have a fallback cert option but it's manual. I'll add runbook steps: how to apply fallback cert and how to revert.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: private-images/upload -> 2026-03-14T02:00:00Z (ETA 10m). Notified oncall.

aaron: On verification — customer will run `sha256sum redwood-inference-aurora-20260314.tar.gz` and post the output to the shared ticket. I'll watch and ack.

maria: Ownership summary: sam = egress ACL PR, ashok = cert rotation + runbook, jen = build + tarball + runbook steps, aaron = customer verification handshake. I'll update the rollout tracker. Anything blocking?

sam: No blockers from infra side. Will ping if terraformplan fails.

ashok: Need one more thing — do we have a preflight that validates proxy can present new cert while existing sessions continue? If not, add a synthetic test against staging proxy.

jen: I'll add a post-deploy smoke that hits `/health` and verifies cert chain. Snippet: ```bash
openssl s_client -connect proxy.internal:443 -servername aurora.example.com </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -text | grep "Subject:"
```

maria: Great. I'll schedule a 15m sync 1h before the handoff window to walk through the final checklist. Ping here when PRs and artifacts are up. :thumbsup:

aaron: Will post SCP endpoint + contact in ~40m.

jen: Upload done. TAR + sha256 posted to secure-artifacts. Link: https://secure-artifacts.internal/aurora/redwood-inference-aurora-20260314.tar.gz

sam: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/482 — includes ACLs for 443,8443. CI plan passed.

ashok: Added cert rotation runbook to /docs/runbooks/cert-rotation.md and linked rollback steps.

maria: All good. If no objections, closing this async sync. We'll reconvene in the live 15m pre-handoff.

jen: :rocket:

aaron: :white_check_mark:
